triples.tail_surface: Remove the bolts holding the motor stand to the pump, remove motor and motor stand and set to one side
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆卸电机支架螺栓并移除电机及支架
triples.evidence_text: Close Coupled Vertical Units: Remove the bolts holding the motor stand to the pump, remove motor and motor stand and set to one side.

triples.tail_surface: Secure shafting safely out of the way or remove shafting if this is not possible
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安全固定传动轴或将其拆除
triples.evidence_text: Remote Coupled Vertical Units: Secure shafting safely out of the way or remove shafting if this is not possible (refer to shafting instructions).

triples.tail_surface: Remove bolts holding the motor to the base and other connections, and then remove the motor from the base
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆卸电机底座螺栓及连接件并移除电机
triples.evidence_text: Horizontal Units: Remove bolts holding the motor to the base and other connections, and then remove the motor from the base.

triples.head_surface: lubrication lines to stuffing box connection and connection leading to bearing below the stuffing box
triples.head_canonical_zh: 填料函润滑管路及轴承连接管路
triples.evidence_text: Remove lubrication lines to stuffing box connection and connection leading to bearing below the stuffing box (if so equipped).

triples.head_surface: bearing temperature detectors, vibration detectors, or other accessories
triples.head_canonical_zh: 轴承温度探测器、振动探测器及其他附件
triples.tail_surface: removed with care, so as not to damage them in any way
triples.evidence_text: If unit was supplied with bearing temperature detectors, vibration detectors, or other accessories subject to damage, these should be removed with care, so as not to damage them in any way.
Any dowel pins that may have been supplied between volute (1) and volute cover (11) joints or other joints affecting bearing alignment should now be removed.

triples.tail_surface: tighten the nut which is provided until the taper pin breaks free
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拧紧螺母直至锥销松脱
triples.evidence_text: Some taper pins are provided with threaded ends. To remove simply tighten the nut which is provided until the taper pin breaks free.

triples.tail_surface: Remove bolts securing volute cover (11) to volute (1)
triples.evidence_text: Remove bolts securing volute cover (11) to volute (1).

triples.head_surface: complete rotating assembly, including volute cover
triples.head_canonical_zh: 含蜗壳盖的完整转子组件
triples.tail_surface: safely removed from volute (1) and set to one side (on timbers to protect finished surfaces)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 从蜗壳安全拆出并垫木放置以保护精加工面
triples.evidence_text: Rig lifting apparatus to pump so that complete rotating assembly, including volute cover can be safely removed from volute ( 1) and set to one side (on timbers to protect finished surfaces) for further disassembly.

triples.tail_surface: pulled straight out until the impeller (2) is clear of volute (1)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 直线拉出转子直至叶轮脱离蜗壳
triples.evidence_text: The rotating assembly should be pulled straight out until the impeller (2) is clear of volute (1).

triples.head_surface: wear rings (8 and 25, if so equipped)
triples.tail_surface: Care should be taken not to rub wear rings (8 and 25, if so equipped) against each other or otherwise damage them
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 小心操作避免耐磨环相互摩擦或受损
triples.evidence_text: Care should be taken not to rub wear rings (8 and 25, if so equipped) against each other or otherwise damage them.

triples.tail_surface: remove bolts securing volute cover support and bearing housing supports to baseplate
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆卸蜗壳盖支架和轴承箱支架到底板的螺栓
triples.evidence_text: NOTE: If pump is a horizontal unit, it will be necessary to remove bolts securing volute cover support and bearing housing supports to baseplate in order to remove the rotating assembly from the volute (1).

triples.tail_surface: unbolted from the pump if obstructed during removal of rotor
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 若转子拆卸受阻则从泵体拆下支架
triples.evidence_text: In addition, the supports may need to be unbolted from the pump if obstructed during removal of rotor.
